definitions.source_lines: Original positive sale lines with a positive remaining quantity at the exclusive training cutoff.
definitions.units: Original sale units less all matched credit units issued strictly before the cutoff, including operational cancellation and return proxies.
definitions.recorded_amount_gbp: Net retained units multiplied by the original sale line price, summed over surviving training purchases.
definitions.repeat_event_share: Net retained basket-item events with an earlier net retained basket for the same customer and SKU / all net retained training basket-item events. Equal timestamps provide no earlier history.
definitions.repeated_pair_share: Observed customer-SKU pairs with a strictly later purchase / all observed training customer-SKU pairs.
definitions.interaction_sparsity: 1 - observed distinct customer-SKU pairs / (active customers x observed SKUs).
definitions.head_items: Ceiling of 10% of observed SKUs, ranked by distinct customers descending, then exact StockCode ascending.
definitions.head_event_share: Events for head SKUs / all training events.
definitions.head_customer_reach_share: Distinct customers with any head SKU / distinct active training customers.
